items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: We went to the Apollo Theater in New York to see Louie Armstrong. He was playing at the County's Inn. Mm-hmm. And we went backstage to see him.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's, but anyway, she was with the Bob Crosby band.

Yeah, she, she stayed with the Bob, she sang on the Fitch bandwagon with us. Mm-hmm. And, and that's when we did the Camel Show and then, and a lot of politics went along and we had to take the Benny Goodman. Yeah. Sing. All these, these are, these are pictures, just copies. Mm-hmm. This is one of the greatest pictures. We went to the Apollo Theater in New York to see Louie Armstrong. He was playing at the County's Inn. Mm-hmm. And we went backstage to see him. This friend, uh, Hal Peterson, uh, not Hal, uh,…
He played banjo with him, see.
